title: Toronto to Niagara Falls Day Tour with Boat Cruise and Lunch
includes: Maple Syrup, Fudge & Chocolate Tasting Experience included
2 Hours Free Time for Self Explore
Air Conditioned Luxury Bus with Experienced Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Hornblower cruise operates between May to December. Replaced by similar attraction in winter
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Niagara Falls on this 9.5-hour Small Group day tour from Downtown Toronto. Skip the lines and enjoy a guided bus tour and a Hornblower Niagara boat cruise, you can between 3 different meals for your Lunch. Enjoy up to 3 Hour free time after your Boat Cruise. After your free time take the ride to Next Stop at Fudge Tasting and sightseeing around the Niagara Gorge.
